description: The integer square root of a non-negative decimal integer, the greatest r with r^2 not exceeding n. isqrt(0) is 0 and isqrt(10) is 3. A leading zero is rejected. n has at most 600 digits. Returns JSON with: n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/isqrt
